main_body: farm building with tiled pitched roof, dormer window, and half-timbered plaster front wall with large barn doors
top_band: tiled roof slope (rows 0-53, with dormer interrupting the middle in rows 16-48) in red-brown and orange-tan roof tiles
evidence: The building clearly shows a large foreshortened top surface (the pitched tiled roof from row 0 to 53) sitting above a vertical front wall (rows 54-88). Under the roof eave (row 53) there is a distinct dark eave shadow band (rows 54-57) cast onto the plaster wall, and the barn doors and windows are recessed into their timber frames.

style.evidence: The candidate directly matches the Beodeul reference houses in tile pattern, 6-step roof ramp (from pale yellow-cream ridge highlights to deep purple-brown shadows), speckled plaster wall texture, and multi-tone wood grain on the barn doors and timber framing. Outlines use dark browns and dark purples matching adjacent materials.
